label: DC Power Supply
description: DC voltage source. Connect + to power rail, – to ground rail.

properties.label: Power On
properties.hint: Turns this supply on or off, like unplugging the battery.

properties.label: Voltage (V)
properties.hint: The voltage this supply provides to whatever it's wired into.

properties.label: Current Limit (mA)
properties.hint: The most current this supply can deliver before it can't keep up, like a battery running low under heavy load.

properties.label: Battery Sag
properties.hint: How much the voltage dips under load as you play — higher settings mimic a tired battery, audibly compressing and "browning out" on loud playing.

properties.label: Internal Resistance (Ω)
properties.hint: How much the supply's own resistance limits current — higher values make Battery Sag more pronounced.
